title: DexCast: Learning Real-World Dexterous Control from Human Videos
abstract: arXiv:2610.14691v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in 3D hand-object interaction (HOI) perception have opened new opportunities for learning dexterous robotic skills from human videos. However, existing dexterous imitation learning methods often rely on costly and manually teleoperated robot demonstrations, requiring substantial human effort. Therefore, we build DEXCAST, a framework that learns dexterous robotic hand control directly from monocular RGB-D videos by leveraging joint HOI reconstructions, without requiring any teleoperation. Furthermore, how to model high-dimensional robotic hand motion and extract temporal context to inform future action generation remains a key challenge. To this end, we propose a DexHand Motion Perception Module (DMPM) to capture inter-joint coordination and temporal dependencies in compact latent representations that condition our diffusion policy. translated_title: DexCast：从人类视频中学习真实世界的灵巧控制
translated_abstract: 三维手-物体交互（HOI）感知的最新进展为从人类视频中学习灵巧机器人技能开辟了新的机会。然而，现有的灵巧模仿学习方法通常依赖昂贵且需要人工遥操作的机器人演示，需要耗费大量人力。因此，我们构建了DEXCAST——一个通过联合HOI重建，直接从单目RGB-D视频中学习灵巧机器人手控制的框架，无需任何遥操作。此外，如何建模高维机器人手部运动并提取时间上下文以指导未来动作生成，仍然是一个关键挑战。为此，我们提出了DexHand运动感知模块（DMPM），以紧凑的潜在表示捕捉关节间的协调性和时间依赖性，并以此作为扩散策略的条件。大量真实世界实验表明，DEXCAST取得了卓越的性能。
tldr: 该论文提出DEXCAST框架，通过联合手-物体交互重建直接从单目RGB-D人类视频中学习灵巧机器人手控制而无需遥操作，并利用DexHand运动感知模块（DMPM）以紧凑潜在表示捕捉关节协调与时间依赖性来条件化扩散策略。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes DEXCAST, a framework that learns real-world dexterous robotic hand control directly from monocular RGB-D human videos without teleoperation, using a DexHand Motion Perception Module (DMPM) to capture inter-joint coordination and temporal dependencies in compact latent representations that condition its diffusion policy.
